column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3:
The roof came down when
some of the men... changed.{page_break}The rest are pinned behind
the rubble, and the water
is rising.{page_break}Will you help dig them out?{end_now}
Thank the mountain. Hurry,\nbefore the water wins.{end_wait}
Then go. The mountain keeps\nwhat it likes. It won't\nforgive you.{end_wait}
Dig for strangers? Half of\nthem will wake wrong. Let\nthe mountain have them.{end_wait}
Mia! They're men, not\nmonsters! Do you hear\nyourself?{end_wait}
You haven't seen what\ncomes back from the mine.\nIsaac has chosen. Dig.{end_wait}
We dig, all of us. Nobody\nstays behind.{end_wait}
They're alive. Most are\nstill themselves. Take this\nbread, it's all we have.{end_wait}
The water's going down.\nThank you. I mean it.{end_wait}
